name: ScrollPrompt
author: simpliplugin

sections.description:
ScrollPrompt displays a small box when a user scrolls past a certain point. Features include:

  • Scroll-depth trigger
  • Email signup or custom message
  • Slide-in from left or right
  • Cookie-based control
  • Mobile-friendly design
  • Device targeting

Planned Features:

  • Multiple boxes per site
  • Split-testing designs
  • Advanced triggers (time on page + scroll)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the scroll-prompt folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin via the ScrollPrompt menu in the admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
Can I show multiple boxes?

The free version supports only one scroll box. The Pro version will support multiple.

How do I change the slide-in position?

Go to ScrollPrompt Settings in the WordPress admin and choose left or right.

short_description: ScrollPrompt displays a scroll-triggered CTA box to engage visitors. Perfect for email signups, promotions, or consultations.
